ambiguities.fragment: enters the access card with the access code
ambiguities.explanation: The prepositional phrase 'with the access code' can attach ambiguously. It is unclear whether the code modifies the action of entering the card, or if the card itself is associated with the code.
possible_interpretations: The user uses the access code to perform the action of entering the access card (Code modifies 'enters').
The user enters an access card that is associated with the access code (Code modifies 'access card').
textual_evidence: The user enters the access card with the access code.
context_evidence: User first inserts the card into the card reader, then enters the access code on the keypad.
